description: HAProxy 2.9 TCP balancer in front of a replicated database.

fields.description: global maxconn: process-wide connection ceiling. Must exceed the total VU count of the workload.
fields.name: maxconn
fields.title: Max connections

fields.description: global log line, "<address> <facility> [<level>]". Empty disables logging.
fields.name: log
fields.title: Log target

fields.description: global nbthread; 0 lets HAProxy bind one thread per available CPU.
fields.name: nbthread
fields.title: Threads

fields.description: global stats socket path used by the agent to read live counters. Empty disables it.
fields.name: stats_socket
fields.title: Stats socket

fields.description: defaults mode. Database wire protocols are opaque to HAProxy, so this is always tcp.
fields.name: mode
fields.title: Mode

fields.description: How long a connection attempt to a backend server may take.
fields.name: timeout_connect
fields.title: timeout connect

fields.description: Inactivity allowed on the client side. Must outlast the longest workload segment or long queries are cut.
fields.name: timeout_client
fields.title: timeout client

fields.description: Inactivity allowed on the server side; mirror timeout client.
fields.name: timeout_server
fields.title: timeout server

fields.description: Timeout of one health check once the connection is established.
fields.name: timeout_check
fields.title: timeout check

fields.description: Connection retries against a backend server before it is declared unreachable.
fields.name: retries
fields.title: Retries

fields.description: Log a line per TCP session (connection times, backend, termination state).
fields.name: option_tcplog
fields.title: option tcplog

fields.description: Custom log-format string; empty keeps the tcplog default format.
fields.name: log_format
fields.title: log-format

fields.description: Serve the HTTP stats page on its own listener; the run detail links to it.
fields.name: stats_enabled
fields.title: Stats page

fields.description: bind port of the stats listener.
fields.name: stats_port
fields.title: Stats port

fields.description: stats uri path.
fields.name: stats_uri
fields.title: Stats URI

fields.description: stats auth "<user>:<password>"; empty leaves the page unauthenticated inside the run network.
fields.name: stats_auth
fields.title: Stats auth

fields.description: One frontend/backend pair per access path (rw, ro, ...). Filled by the server from topology.
Proxy name; also the log tag.
fields.name: name
fields.title: Name

fields.description: Port this listener binds on all interfaces.
fields.name: bind_port
fields.title: Bind port

fields.description: Proxy mode; tcp for every database protocol.
fields.name: mode
fields.title: Mode

fields.description: Load-balancing algorithm. leastconn suits long-lived database connections; roundrobin a read fan-out; source pins a client to one node.
fields.name: balance
fields.title: Balance

fields.description: tcp = a bare connect; httpchk = an HTTP request against the node's REST API (Patroni, and any other role-reporting endpoint).
fields.name: kind
fields.title: Check kind

fields.description: http-check send meth.
fields.name: method
fields.title: Method

fields.description: http-check send uri. Patroni: /primary is 200 only on the leader, /replica only on a running replica (optionally /replica?lag=1MB).
fields.name: uri
fields.title: URI

fields.description: http-check expect status.
fields.name: expect_status
fields.title: Expected status

fields.description: server ... check port: the REST API port, not the database port. Patroni listens on 8008.
fields.name: port
fields.title: Check port

fields.description: default-server inter: seconds between checks.
fields.name: inter
fields.title: Check interval

fields.description: default-server fall: failed checks before a server is taken out.
fields.name: fall
fields.title: Fall

fields.description: default-server rise: successful checks before a server is put back.
fields.name: rise
fields.title: Rise

fields.description: server name in the config and in the logs.
fields.name: name
fields.title: Name

fields.description: Backend address. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.name: address
fields.title: Address

fields.description: Backend database port.
fields.name: port
fields.title: Port

fields.description: server weight for the balancing algorithm.
fields.name: weight
fields.title: Weight

fields.description: server backup: used only when every non-backup server is down.
fields.name: backup
fields.title: Backup

fields.description: server maxconn: per-backend connection ceiling; 0 leaves it unlimited.
fields.name: maxconn
fields.title: Max connections

fields.name: listeners
fields.title: Listeners

computed.expr:
("listeners" in root) ? root.listeners.map(l,
					"listen " + l.name + "\n" +
					"    bind *:" + string(l.bind_port) + "\n" +
					"    mode " + l.mode + "\n" +
					"    balance " + l.balance + "\n" +
					(l.check.kind == "httpchk"
						? "    option httpchk\n" +
						  "    http-check send meth " + l.check.method + " uri " + l.check.uri + "\n" +
						  "    http-check expect status " + string(l.check.expect_status) + "\n"
						: "    option tcp-check\n") +
					"    default-server inter " + string(l.check.inter) +
						"s fall " + string(l.check.fall) +
						" rise " + string(l.check.rise) +
						" on-marked-down shutdown-sessions\n" +
					l.servers.map(s,
						"    server " + s.name + " " + s.address + ":" + string(s.port) +
						" check port " + string(l.check.port) +
						" weight " + string(s.weight) +
						(s.maxconn > 0 ? " maxconn " + string(s.maxconn) : "") +
						(s.backup ? " backup" : "")
					).join("\n")
				).join("\n\n") : ""

fields.description: Derived: every listen block with its servers.
fields.name: listener_blocks
fields.title: Rendered proxy blocks

computed.expr:
!root.stats_enabled ? "" :
				 "listen stats\n" +
				 "    bind *:" + string(root.stats_port) + "\n" +
				 "    mode http\n" +
				 "    stats enable\n" +
				 "    stats uri " + root.stats_uri + "\n" +
				 "    stats refresh 5s" +
				 (root.stats_auth == "" ? "" : "\n    stats auth " + root.stats_auth)

(root.log == "" ? "" : "    log " + root.log + "
") +
				 (root.nbthread == 0 ? "" : "    nbthread " + string(root.nbthread) + "
") +
				 (root.stats_socket == "" ? "" : "    stats socket " + root.stats_socket + " mode 660 level admin
")

(root.log == "" ? "" : "    log global
") +
				 (root.option_tcplog ? "    option tcplog
" : "") +
				 (root.log_format == "" ? "" : "    log-format " + root.log_format + "
")

rules.message: a listener cannot bind the stats port
global maxconn must cover at least one connection per backend server
